lead: Comedic cinematic film still, bright white office, brown mud, mustard yellow hazmat suit, green plants.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Poo Storm Janitor Powersuit.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "Poo Storm Janitor Powersuit-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "Poo Storm Janitor Powersuit-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line, with the muck called mud; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: storm
images.prompt: An office covered in brown mud from floor to ceiling, mud splattered on the desks and dripping from a standing fan.

images.name: company
images.prompt: A small yellow cleaning company van parked in front of a gleaming corporate glass office tower.

images.name: monster
images.prompt: A lumpy brown mud monster running through an office, flinging mud at a standing fan.

images.name: office
images.prompt: A worker in a yellow hazmat suit vacuuming brown mud off an office floor.

images.name: campaign
images.prompt: A row of office buildings on a city street, a cleaning crew's van driving between them.

images.name: log
images.prompt: A clipboard of work orders on a desk, each sheet stamped with a red rubber stamp.

images.name: break
images.prompt: A worker in a yellow hazmat suit resting on an office chair beside a tall green potted plant.

images.name: muck
images.prompt: Empty office with no people: thick brown mud dripping off the edge of a white desk onto white floor tiles.

images.name: cooler
images.prompt: A blue water cooler tank lying on its side on a muddy white office floor.

images.name: fight
images.prompt: A worker in a yellow hazmat suit spraying a water hose at a lumpy brown mud creature in an office.
